title: LouisAgent.Evals.Contracts: the overview
caption: The records a run is made of, and the API's rows of them, on nothing of ours, so the evals write them, the API sends them and a page in the browser reads them, one shape for all three.

cards.title: LouisAgent.Evals.Contracts
cards.text: One shape for a run, from the file it is kept in to the page that draws it.

cards.title: What happened
cards.text: A turn as the agent did it: the ask, the answer as sent, each tool call with its result.

cards.title: Its marks
cards.text: A fact's or a criterion's mark with its reason, and a turn with all of them, the agent's cost and the judge's.

cards.title: The run
cards.text: A run's conversations and repeats, each saying whether it passed.

cards.title: The API's rows
cards.text: What the eval routes list, with each run's two costs and a live run's estimate, and what a start asks for.
